These suites exercise native CLI adapter contracts, physical subprocesses, real SQLite/concurrency, real loopback HTTP and OS resource measurements. Clearly labelled fixture CLI output does not establish live model inference. Windows SYSTEM/ACL/Job Object integration tests deliberately skip on Linux. No persistent service is needed for these development checks.

Read docs/PIPELINE_4.2.2.md and docs/REQUIREMENTS_4.2.2.md. Do not try to bypass the Linux fail-closed guard or claim Windows acceptance here. The existing scientific library remains available. Optional GPU/ML, ORCA/CREST/xTB/Open Babel, unrelated legacy v4 suites and their known Windows-dependent failures are outside the pipeline readiness claim.
